tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Redstick's dated record of construction robots, software and AI tools by words, job, trade or kind. Free. Returns up to 10 tools a call, each with what it does, who it suits, the catch and the price as the maker states it.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One tool from Redstick's record in full: the verdict, the source read, features, where it is sold and what it connects to, as it stands today. Free.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: The jobs on site that tools on Redstick's record are filed under, each with its stage of the work. Free.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: The trades that tools on Redstick's record are filed under. Free.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: The systems and file formats that tools on Redstick's record say they connect to, with how many tools name each. Free. Without q, only systems named by three or more tools.
